pages.title: Portable Scanner
pages.text: The Portable Scanner shows you the air quality wherever you are. Hold it in your hand to see the CO2, Oxygen, and Toxin bars on your screen. It holds $(bold)5,000 FE$() and drains $(bold)2 FE per tick$() while active.

pages.title: Using It
pages.text: $(bold)Sneak + right-click$() to turn the scanner on or off. When it runs out of energy, it turns off automatically. Recharge it by placing it in a Power Bank's slot. The scanner shows the same HUD as the hazmat helmet.
Useful before you have a full hazmat suit.
